About Me

Hello! I'm Luis Adrian.

I'm a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology student with an interest in software development and web technologies.

I enjoy exploring different programming languages, developing applications, and creating user-friendly websites. Through my academic projects and personal learning experiences, I continue to improve my technical skills, problem-solving abilities, and understanding of software development.

My goal is to continue growing as an IT professional, gain practical industry experience, and develop solutions that are both useful and accessible to people.

What I've worked on

Featured Project

Academic work applying information technology to a practical business need.

Academic / School Capstone Project

MOTHERMADE

BRC20 Fashion Couture

MOTHERMADE is an online ordering and rental management system designed to simplify garment ordering, gown rentals, inventory management, and production monitoring.

The platform integrates AI-powered design sketch generation, garment image enhancement, customer measurement input, and online payment processing to provide a more convenient and organized experience for customers and business administrators.

Key Features

  • Online garment ordering and gown rentals
  • Inventory management and production monitoring
  • AI-powered design sketch generation
  • Garment image enhancement
  • Customer measurement input
  • Online payment processing
